title: Startup items
description: See what launches at sign-in or when background conditions are met. Third-party items are explained first; system services are never presented as ordinary switches.

guided.title: Startup items worth reviewing
guided.description: Only third-party sign-in items that can be safely restored appear here.
guided.foundDescription: Apps you rarely use can be disabled after confirmation; the change applies at the next sign-in.
guided.clear: No third-party sign-in item needs attention
guided.clearDescription: System services and conditional maintenance items are never presented as ordinary switches.

loadingDescription: StatusOrbit only reads public startup configuration and never loads or runs the commands inside it.
reviewHint: Third-party items that launch at sign-in
systemHint: Read-only and never shown as ordinary switches
emptyDescription: Switch to All to inspect conditional and system maintenance items.
managementBoundary: Only reversible user-level third-party startup files can be disabled. System items and unsupported sources stay read-only.
readOnlyBoundary: This platform exposes no startup source StatusOrbit can safely restore, so the inventory remains read-only.
unreadable: {{count}} startup locations could not be read due to permissions

managementStatus.unsupported: This source is not manageable yet

impact.notMatched: No currently running app could be matched

outcome.disabled: Automatic startup for {{name}} is disabled. The running app was not closed.

disable.title: Disable automatic startup for {{name}}?
disable.description: StatusOrbit moves this user-level startup file into its own recoverable storage and does not delete it.
disable.whenDescription: This takes effect at the next sign-in. Restoring it also takes effect from a future sign-in.

enable.title: Restore automatic startup for {{name}}?
enable.description: StatusOrbit moves the configuration it saved back to the original location.
enable.whenDescription: From the next sign-in, the system can launch this item automatically again.

actionDialog.reversibleDescription: The file only moves between two user folders and is never edited or deleted.
actionDialog.whenTitle: The current session does not change immediately
actionDialog.runningDescription: Disabling startup does not quit the current app or interrupt work already in progress.
actionDialog.preparing: Verifying the startup item and file state…

errors.startup_item_protected: This is not a user-level third-party startup item StatusOrbit can manage safely, so nothing changed.
errors.startup_item_unavailable: This startup item changed or disappeared. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.startup_state_changed: The startup file changed after confirmation, so StatusOrbit changed nothing.
errors.startup_destination_conflict: Another configuration appeared at the destination. StatusOrbit refused to overwrite it.
errors.startup_confirmation_unavailable: This confirmation is no longer available. Cancel and open it again.
errors.startup_confirmation_expired: The confirmation expired. Review the item again before continuing.
errors.startup_management_failed: The system could not move the startup file safely. The original state was preserved.

review.title: Consider whether you need it
review.description: It launches every time you sign in. If you rarely use it, you can disable it after confirmation.

normal.title: Runs conditionally
normal.description: It usually starts for updates, sync, or a specific event and may not slow sign-in.

system.title: System or device service
system.description: Do not treat this as an ordinary startup app. StatusOrbit keeps it read-only.

disabled.title: Currently disabled
disabled.description: The configuration remains, but the system will not start it automatically from this entry.
